instruction:
I want VLC to always start videos in paused state instead of playing automatically. Please enable the start paused option.
How can I configure this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's start paused feature (start-paused=1). Created custom metric function check_vlc_start_paused__443cb77a. Expected value is 1 (enabled).
